status_semantics.source_pointer: Issuer PDF page 27, printed slide 26, Rai Potential Capacity and separate Future Plan blocks; adjacent page 26, printed slide 25, Manesar and Panchkula blocks.
status_semantics.assessment: In the full infrastructure section, the Rai wording is more consistent with work to convert or fit out an existing building for 20 MW of data-center capacity than with a cloud-service rollout alone. This is a contextual inference, not a literal description of a particular construction trade or activity.
status_semantics.supporting_context: Rai distinguishes a ready building capable of 100 MW IT load, commenced work for an initial 20 MW, and a separate future 100 MW greenfield plan. The adjacent Manesar and Panchkula blocks explicitly describe operational capacity and cloud/colocation service expansion. The general vendor page is not attributed as proof of work at Rai.
status_semantics.temporal_limit: The signed August 11 disclosure repeats a historical commencement formulation under Potential Capacity. It does not unambiguously state when physical work was observed or affirm contemporaneous ongoing physical work. Publication is not onset; no June 30 physical-observation date is assigned. Earlier stale discovery references warn against treating August 11 as a new start, but are not selected as current status.
status_semantics.acceptance_standard_preserved: A fresh authoritative general statement that a named project is under construction can qualify without a named civil, MEP or installation milestone. Missing trade-level detail is not a universal additional gate. The unresolved issue here is whether this particular historical work-commenced wording establishes current physical work within the fixed window, together with the independent locator-identity gap.
status_semantics.completion_scope: Ready building and completed office-space descriptions concern the existing shell/property and do not alone establish completion of the proposed 20 MW data-center conversion. Conversely, no definite current-build status is inferred merely from the absence of a completion notice.
status_semantics.excluded_phase: The separate future 100 MW greenfield plan and the 200 MW headline are not selected as active construction.
status_semantics.decision: Hold preserved pending root adjudication or a clear fresh authoritative current physical-work statement; no date or status upgrade.
